notes.title: Optimization and Bug Fix Attempts (1.1.5.5)
notes.content:
Changed the slot machine loot drop logic from providing a variable to location to directly writing the position, converting location to transform instead of using set transform, attempting to fix the issue of items not dropping.

Attempted to fix a bug where the giant door could crush the player and destroy the player character’s information.

Fixed the issue of the giant cube causing armor collision problems.

Fixed the cloud save bug. However, if you have previously attempted to sync on a new computer, you need to manually delete your save files for the fix to take full effect.
Save folder: C:\Users\(Your Username)\AppData\Local\UncannyLabyrinth\Saved\SaveGames

Redesigned collisions for many objects that were using complex collision as simple collision, as this often caused clipping issues. This large-scale optimization reduces the chance of clipping.

tags.bug: Attempted to fix a bug where the giant door could crush the player and destroy the player character’s information.
Fixed the issue of the giant cube causing armor collision problems.

Save folder: C:\Users\(Your Username)\AppData\Local\UncannyLabyrinth\Saved\SaveGames

notes.title: Week 1 Patch Notes (v1.1.3.5): Major Quality of Life Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Here’s what’s new in version [b]1.1.3.5[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Blocking Reworked[/b] – You can now block at any time, without waiting for the attack animation to finish. This significantly improves responsiveness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982963/32374f1ed42a1bcaa27b759d5116170b8bb5f306.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Tutorial[/b] – New players are now guided to craft a torch, helping them survive the first night without rage-quitting due to total darkness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death Camera Optimized[/b] – Now forces third-person view upon death to prevent camera glitches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fertilizer Spray Buffed[/b] – Usages increased from 10 to 20 sprays per can.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Soldier Area Exit Changed[/b] – The return portal is now an elevator to prevent confusion about its purpose.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Highlights from the first week of updates:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Cleaned Up UI[/b] – Simplified interface for better clarity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982963/2b0839c3fc4d8a56dc77b76634f9377dcaa3e494.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Frame Rate Limit Setting[/b] – Players can now cap FPS to suit their needs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982963/286a80fdfc337984c34ffd25396df0e282bb2a93.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reconnect Fixes[/b] – Fixed issue where players had to restart the game after disconnecting or being kicked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Game Improvements[/b] – Added more hint items, reduced difficulty, and improved level logic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Toggle for Crouch and Sprint[/b] – More control customization options.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982963/5542adb0c1c10a4514bb484f9d726ed90c55aaaa.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Balanced Resource Distribution & Weapon Stats[/b] – Improved gameplay pacing and combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix: Unlocking on Client Side[/b] – Resolved issues where achievements or unlocks weren’t registering properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Building System Tweaks[/b] – Easier to distinguish structure orientations; items stored in crafting benches now drop correctly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982963/5f60b135c72c130794f7291556b70e0cf84babbe.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster Logic Fixes[/b] – Monsters are now less likely to get stuck in walls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse Sensitivity Save[/b] – Sensitivity settings now persist between sessions.[/p][/*][/olist]

tags.feature: Blocking Reworked – You can now block at any time, without waiting for the attack animation to finish. This significantly improves responsiveness.
Improved Tutorial – New players are now guided to craft a torch, helping them survive the first night without rage-quitting due to total darkness.

tags.bug: Death Camera Optimized – Now forces third-person view upon death to prevent camera glitches.

tags.balance_change: Fertilizer Spray Buffed – Usages increased from 10 to 20 sprays per can.

tags.feature: Soldier Area Exit Changed – The return portal is now an elevator to prevent confusion about its purpose.
Cleaned Up UI – Simplified interface for better clarity.
Added Frame Rate Limit Setting – Players can now cap FPS to suit their needs.

tags.bug: Reconnect Fixes – Fixed issue where players had to restart the game after disconnecting or being kicked.

tags.feature: Early Game Improvements – Added more hint items, reduced difficulty, and improved level logic.
Added Toggle for Crouch and Sprint – More control customization options.

tags.balance_change: Balanced Resource Distribution & Weapon Stats – Improved gameplay pacing and combat.

tags.bug: Bug Fix: Unlocking on Client Side – Resolved issues where achievements or unlocks weren’t registering properly.
Building System Tweaks – Easier to distinguish structure orientations; items stored in crafting benches now drop correctly.
Monster Logic Fixes – Monsters are now less likely to get stuck in walls.
Mouse Sensitivity Save – Sensitivity settings now persist between sessions.
